origin: Researcher-designed, 2026-09-22/23, direct continuation of the retired overlap_momentum_scalp line -- reuses its one validated mechanism (deviation-from-SMA fade) unchanged, testing across multiple pairs to find a better gross-edge-to-fixed-commission ratio than EURUSD.r showed.
symbol: to be determined per test run -- candidates GBPUSD.r, USDJPY, GBPJPY.r
thesis: Same as overlap_momentum_scalp v3: fade price's deviation from a 20-period M1 SMA during the London/NY overlap, volatility-adaptive threshold. Hypothesis under test: a more volatile pair may carry the same fixed per-lot commission as a smaller fraction of a larger typical target, making the mechanism economically viable where EURUSD wasn't.

entry.trigger: deviation from 20-period M1 SMA >= max(MinDeviationPipsFloor, MinDeviationVsAvgMultiplier * rolling average of the last DeviationHistoryWindow session bars' own deviations)
entry.side: fade -- sell if price above the mean, buy if below
skip_conditions: computed lot size below broker minimum

stop_loss: max(MinStopPips, deviation size in pips * SLMultiplier)

exit.rule: market close MaxHoldMinutes after entry if SL/TP not hit, or immediately at session end (18:00 server)

tunable_parameters_to_sweep: MinDeviationVsAvgMultiplier, SLMultiplier, TPMultiplier -- per-symbol, not yet swept for any new symbol.
